integrity: The complete analytic argument and executable numerical cross-checks accompany the result. Numerical checks corroborate but do not constitute a proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula concerns the zero-force derivative of the quadratic-in-activity conditional mean-time difference, at fixed positive diffusivity. The sharp small-diffusivity expansion applies after these derivatives; no fixed-nonzero-force or uniform joint-limit claim is made. The global sign at arbitrary diffusivity is not asserted.
title: Sharp weak-force asymmetry in active Brownian first-passage times
